name: Verse Heart
summary: A turning 3D heart built from many lines of the words i love you, with your own words
about: About fifteen hundred letters fly in from all around and build a 3D heart out of thirty rings of text that read i love you, or any words you type. It turns slowly, beats with a soft glow, dims the letters at the back and leans away from your mouse; drag to turn it and tap to burst the letters out so they spring back. Good for a love message, an anniversary or Valentine's page, or a short video with Clean view.
how: Watch the letters fly in and build the heart; it then turns and beats on its own.
Drag to turn and tilt it (or use the arrow keys on it), tap it or press the star button to burst the letters.
Type your own words and a name, pick one of four colours, and switch Spin and Heartbeat on or off.
Press Clean view to hide the controls for a screen recording; Escape brings them back.
Copy the link to send your heart, save a picture, or build it again; with reduced motion it stays still but drag and every control still work.
